hero.title: Invite smarter.
hero.body: LYST is a digital invitation and event experience platform — bringing together the details, RSVPs, interactions, and memories your guests create, all in one place.

techEmotion.body: LYST turns a digital invitation into one seamless event experience — making hosting effortless and turning guests into co-authors of shared memories.

features.title: Anticipation
features.body: Before the event, LYST builds anticipation and gives guests everything they need to know in one place.

features.title: Participation
features.body: During the event, guests respond, join in, and help shape the shared experience themselves.

features.title: Memory
features.body: After the event, photos, voices, and messages live on as one vivid digital memory.

guestExperience.title: The invitation is just the beginning.
guestExperience.body: LYST gives guests one continuous experience — before, during, and after the event. Every important detail, response, and interaction stays in the same place.

hostDashboard.title: Everything. At a glance.
hostDashboard.body: Guest lists, RSVPs, statuses, and key details — all gathered in one dashboard. Less chaos, fewer messages, and complete control.

featureShowcase.title: More than an invitation.
featureShowcase.body: Guests leave voice messages right from their phones — heartfelt words, toasts, and emotions that live on long after the event.

record.label: Record a voice message
record.heading: Tap to record
record.body: Record a short voice message. Once you're done, you can listen back and send it.

moments: Your best friend's voice, trembling with emotion
A message you'll read again years from now

finalCta.title: Your event deserves more than an invitation.
finalCta.body: Create an experience that reaches your guests before the event, stays with them during it, and lingers long after it ends.
